q: Battleship 这个题里，`check_shot(row, col)` 的返回值可能表示哪些状态？
q_en: In this Battleship problem, what states can `check_shot(row, col)` return?
options: HIT——命中了尚未被摧毁的船格
SUNK——这一枪正好击沉一艘船
MISS——空水域，或重复射击已打过的格子
返回船的完整坐标列表（这个 API 不会给你）
options_en: HIT — the shot landed on a ship cell that isn't destroyed yet
SUNK — this exact shot was the one that sank a ship
MISS — open water, or a repeat of a cell you already fired at
The full coordinate list of a ship (the API never gives you this)
why: API 只反馈 HIT、SUNK、MISS 三类局部信息，不直接告诉你整艘船的位置。重复射击也算 MISS 且计入发射次数，所以解法必须自己避重。
why_en: The API exposes only local shot feedback, so the solver must infer structure and avoid repeated shots itself.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：传入 (row, col)，返回 HIT/SUNK/MISS 三选一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: check_shot is the given API call that takes a row and column and returns HIT, SUNK, or MISS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 命中了船格，但这艘船还没被完全打沉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HIT means the shot landed on a ship cell that hasn't been fully sunk yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 这一枪刚好是某艘船的最后一个格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SUNK means this exact shot destroyed the last remaining cell of a ship.

termDefinitions.meaning: 打在空水域，或者重复射击了已经打过的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MISS means the shot hit open water, or repeated a cell that was already fired at.

optionExplanations: check_shot 确实会返回 HIT，表示这一枪命中了还没沉没的船格。
SUNK 是真实返回值，专门标记这一枪正好打沉了整艘船的最后一格。
MISS 也是真实返回值，覆盖打空水域和重复射击两种情况。
常见误解：API 只给单点反馈，不会一次性吐出整艘船的坐标，得自己拼。
optionExplanations_en: check_shot really returns HIT when a shot lands on a ship cell that's still standing.
SUNK is a real return value marking the exact shot that finishes off a ship.
MISS is also real, covering both open water and a repeated shot.
Common misread: the API never hands you a ship's coordinate list, you infer it shot by shot.
scenario: 你要在 10x10 棋盘上自己推断船的位置，唯一的信息来源是每枪的返回值。
scenario_en: On a 10x10 board you must infer ship positions yourself, and per-shot return values are your only information.

q: 填空：效率测试在 {{10x10}} 棋盘上跑 {{20}} 个随机布局，平均枪数必须少于 {{50}}。
q_en: Fill in: the efficiency test uses a {{10x10}} board, {{20}} random layouts, and an average under {{50}} shots.
text: 效率测试在 {{10x10}} 棋盘上跑 {{20}} 个随机布局，平均枪数必须少于 {{50}}。
why: 10x10、20 局取平均、50 枪预算，这是给定的验收目标而不是推导出的数字；它决定了后面必须放弃完整扫描，换成能兼顾覆盖和省枪的策略。
why_en: The 50-shot budget is a given acceptance target, not a derived number, and it is what forces the design away from a naive full scan.

scenario: 你只需要先写一个一定能击沉所有船的基线解法，暂时不考虑 10x10 的枪数预算。
scenario_en: You only need a correctness baseline that can sink every ship; ignore the 10x10 shot budget for now.
q: 最合适的第一版策略是什么？
q_en: What is the best first-version strategy?
options: 按行列完整扫描所有格子，射击后检查 `all_sunk()`
随机射击，直到某艘船返回 SUNK 就停手
只打 `(row + col) % 3 == 0` 的格子，命中后也不追击
从棋盘四个角同时向中心搜索
options_en: Scan every cell row by row, firing and checking `all_sunk()` after each shot
Fire at random cells and stop as soon as any single SUNK comes back
Only fire at cells where `(row + col) % 3 == 0`, and never chase after a hit
Search inward from all four corners of the board toward the center
tradeoff: 确定性覆盖保证 vs 射击预算效率
why: 完整扫描利用棋盘有限这一事实保证正确性，并且实现最少。它的问题不是会漏船，而是不会利用 HIT 信息。
why_en: A full scan is the simplest correctness baseline because a finite grid guarantees every ship cell is eventually probed.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是通过平均枪数测试，而不是只验证最终击沉，稀疏 hunt 加 target 模式会更合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：判断舰队里所有船是否都已经沉没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: all_sunk is the given API that reports whether every ship in the fleet has been destroyed.

termDefinitions.meaning: check_shot 返回值之一：这一枪刚好是某艘船的最后一个格子。

termDefinitions.meaning: hunt 阶段用的稀疏格局：只打行列坐标之和能被 3 整除的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modulo-three pattern only fires at cells where row plus column is divisible by three.

optionExplanations: 行列扫描能保证每个格子迟早被打到，所以一定能拿到全绿的 `all_sunk()`。
只要打沉一艘就收手，舰队里其它船会被直接漏掉，起不到基线作用。
mod-3 稀疏格局虽然省枪，但要先假设最短船长为 3，这一版还没引入这个前提。
四角向心搜索没有覆盖证明，可能在中心区域留下没打到的格子。
optionExplanations_en: A row-by-row sweep is guaranteed to touch every cell eventually, so `all_sunk()` always turns true.
Stopping after one SUNK leaves the rest of the fleet unfired at, so it can't serve as a baseline.
The mod-3 sparse pattern only works once you assume a minimum ship length of three, not set up yet here.
Searching inward from the corners has no coverage proof and can leave center cells untouched.

scenario: 你在完整扫描里已经射中最后一格并让 `all_sunk()` 变为 true。
scenario_en: In the full scan, you have just hit the last ship cell and `all_sunk()` is now true.
q: 下面哪行控制流最应该保留？
q_en: Which control-flow line should you keep?
options: `continue`，继续扫完这一行
`return`，立刻结束求解
`break`，只跳出内层循环再扫下一行
`random.shuffle(shots)`，打乱历史记录
options_en: `continue` — keep scanning through the rest of this row
`return` — stop the solver immediately
`break` — only exit the inner column loop, then move to the next row
`random.shuffle(shots)` — shuffle the recorded shot history
tradeoff: 立即停止节省无意义枪数 vs 让循环结构继续走完更简单
codeSample:
self.board.check_shot(row, col)
self.shots.append((row, col))
if self.board.all_sunk():
    return
why: 最后一艘船沉没后继续射击只会增加无意义枪数。完整扫描虽然朴素，但早停能省掉最后一次 SUNK 后面的尾部扫描。
why_en: The solver should return immediately after all ships are sunk because every later probe is wasted budget.
whenOtherWins: 如果 API 要求输出完整覆盖轨迹而不是最少枪数，扫完棋盘才可能有意义。

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：判断舰队里所有船是否都已经沉没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: all_sunk is the given API that reports whether every ship in the fleet has been destroyed.

optionExplanations: continue 只跳过当前格，扫描还会一路打到棋盘结尾，白白多耗几十枪。
return 能在所有船刚沉没的那一刻退出循环，后面的格子不用再打。
break 只退出内层循环，外层行遍历照样接着跑，尾部浪费没有真正解决。
shuffle 是在乱改已经打过的坐标记录，跟这里要不要停手完全是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: continue only skips the current cell, the scan keeps firing all the way to the last row.
return exits the loop the instant every ship is sunk, so no later cell gets fired at.
break only escapes the inner loop, the outer row loop keeps going, tail waste isn't fixed.
Shuffling the recorded shots is a different concern from deciding when to stop firing.

scenario: 你想判断完整扫描能不能满足 10x10 效率测试的 50 枪预算，需要先估算它最坏情况下的开销量级。
scenario_en: To decide whether full scan can meet the 50-shot budget on 10x10, first estimate its worst-case shot count.
q: 完整扫描在 n x n 棋盘上的最坏射击次数是多少量级？
q_en: What is the worst-case shot complexity of full scan on an n x n board?
options: O(n)
O(n log n)
O(3n)
options_en: O(n) — linear in the board dimension
O(n log n) — linearithmic in the board dimension
O(n^2) — quadratic in the board dimension
O(3n) — three times the board dimension
why: 行列嵌套循环最多访问 n² 个格子，最坏情况是 O(n^2)；10x10 时上界接近 100 枪，已经超过 50 枪预算，这正是后面要换 hunt+target 的原因。
why_en: A row-column scan can touch up to n squared cells, so its worst case is O(n^2), which on a 10x10 board approaches 100 shots and blows past the 50-shot budget.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大 O 记号：描述算法最坏情况开销随输入规模 n 的增长速度，这里是二次增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes how an algorithm's worst-case cost grows with input size n; here it grows quadratically.

optionExplanations: O(n) 只对应单层循环，扫描棋盘明明是两层嵌套，量级对不上。
O(n log n) 通常来自排序类操作，这里没有任何排序步骤，套用不上。
行乘列两层循环最多访问 n×n 个格子，量级正是平方级。
O(3n) 是线性量级的一种写法，跟嵌套两层循环的实际开销不符。
optionExplanations_en: O(n) fits a single loop, but scanning a grid is two nested loops, the order doesn't match.
O(n log n) usually comes from a sort step, and there's no sorting happening here.
Two nested loops over rows and columns touch up to n times n cells, exactly quadratic.
O(3n) is still a linear form and doesn't match the cost of two nested loops.

q: 填空：完整扫描基本保持 {{无状态}}，因为命中、漏打和沉船状态都由 {{Board}} 管理。
q_en: Fill in: full scan is almost {{stateless}} because hit, miss, and sunk state is managed by the {{Board}}.
text: 完整扫描基本保持 {{无状态}}，因为命中、漏打和沉船状态都由 {{Board}} 管理。
why: 扫描解法只按固定顺序调用 API，把射击坐标记录进 shots；它没有把 HIT/MISS 反馈转成下一枪的决策状态。
why_en: The full scan stays nearly stateless because the board object owns all game state and the solver just replays a fixed order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的棋盘对象，负责保存命中/未命中/沉船状态并响应 check_shot。

q: 完整扫描和 hunt+target 的关键区别是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between full scan and hunt+target?
options: 完整扫描会重复打同一格，hunt+target 不会
完整扫描不看反馈，hunt+target 按 HIT/SUNK 调整下一枪
完整扫描必须用 BFS 逐层遍历整个棋盘，hunt+target 完全不用队列
完整扫描只打 3 格船，hunt+target 只打 2 格船
options_en: Full scan can repeat the same cell, hunt+target never does
Full scan ignores feedback, hunt+target adjusts from HIT/SUNK
Full scan must use BFS to sweep the whole board layer by layer, and hunt+target needs no queue at all
Full scan only handles 3-cell ships, hunt+target handles 2-cell ships
tradeoff: 开环固定顺序（简单，不利用反馈） vs 闭环反馈驱动（省枪，多一层状态）
why: 完整扫描是开环流程，反馈只用于停止判断。hunt+target 是闭环流程，命中会把周围格子推入目标队列。
why_en: The optimized solver closes the loop by feeding shot feedback into the next-shot decision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 广度优先搜索：先均匀探完当前层所有邻居，再往外扩一层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS explores all neighbors at the current layer before expanding further out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 命中了船格，但这艘船还没被完全打沉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HIT means the shot landed on a ship cell that hasn't been fully sunk yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 这一枪刚好是某艘船的最后一个格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SUNK means this exact shot destroyed the last remaining cell of a ship.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  Full[Full scan] --> Fixed[Fixed next shot]
  Hit[HIT feedback] --> Target[Target queue]
  Target --> Adaptive[Adaptive next shot]
optionExplanations: 去重靠 `tried` 集合单独维护，跟扫描顺序无关，两种解法其实都可能重复打同一格。
完整扫描按固定读序走，不看上一枪结果；hunt+target 拿到 HIT/SUNK 就把下一枪改成邻居格。
两种解法都是按坐标调用 `check_shot`，谈不上谁需要 BFS，队列只是 hunt+target 用来追击的结构。
两种解法处理的是同一支舰队，船长限制不会因为算法换了就跟着变。
optionExplanations_en: Dedup is handled separately by a `tried` set regardless of scan order, both solvers can hit repeats without it.
Full scan follows a fixed order and ignores results; hunt+target turns a HIT/SUNK into the next probe.
Both call `check_shot` by coordinate, neither needs BFS, the queue is just how hunt+target chases hits.
Both solvers face the same fleet, ship-length rules don't change just because the algorithm changed.
scenario: 10x10 上完整扫描平均 68 枪超预算，你要判断 hunt+target 省在哪一步。
scenario_en: Full scan averages about 68 shots on 10x10 and blows the budget; you need to see where hunt+target saves shots.

scenario: 10x10 测试里，完整扫描平均约 68.30 枪，超过 50 枪预算。
scenario_en: On the 10x10 benchmark, a full scan averages about 68.30 shots, above the 50-shot budget.
q: 完整扫描的 benchmark 最直接说明什么？
q_en: What does the full-scan benchmark most directly show?
text: 完整扫描能打完，但过不了预算；优化重点是{{提升每枪的信息量}}。
why: 「能打完」不等于「能通过优化测试」；68.30 枪已经超过 50 枪预算，瓶颈在于每一枪的信息利用率，不是能不能击沉。
why_en: Finishing the game is not the same as passing the benchmark: 68.30 shots already exceeds the 50-shot budget because the scan wastes the information each shot provides.

scenario: 你刚在搜索阶段得到一个 HIT，但还不知道船是横向还是纵向。
scenario_en: You just got a HIT during search, but you do not know whether the ship is horizontal or vertical.
q: 下一步最合理的局部策略是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable local next step?
options: 回到行优先扫描的下一个格子
把命中格子的上下左右邻居加入 target 队列
只继续向右射击直到越界
停止并等待 `all_sunk()` 变 true
options_en: Go back to the next cell in row-major scan order
Push the hit cell's four neighbors onto the target queue
Keep firing rightward only, until running off the board
Stop firing and wait for `all_sunk()` to become true
tradeoff: 四邻域局部追击（省枪但要维护队列状态） vs 回到盲扫（简单但浪费已知信息）
why: 船是连续且轴对齐的，所以命中后下一格船身很可能在四邻域里。先探索四邻居能尽快确定方向并击沉。
why_en: After a hit, the four adjacent cells are the highest-value probes because ships are contiguous and axis-aligned.
whenOtherWins: 如果船可以任意弯曲或不连续，四邻域追击就不再有这个结构性优势。

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：判断舰队里所有船是否都已经沉没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: all_sunk is the given API that reports whether every ship in the fleet has been destroyed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 闭环追击阶段维护的候选坐标队列，命中后把邻居坐标放进去。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The target queue holds candidate coordinates queued after a hit, driving the chase phase.

optionExplanations: 退回盲扫顺序等于扔掉刚拿到的命中信息，等于从头再猜一次。
还不知道船朝哪边延伸时，把四邻居都排进队列才不会漏掉真正的船身。
只往右打是在赌船一定朝右延伸，船朝左或朝上下时这一枪全打空。
干等 `all_sunk()` 不会主动补枪，命中后不追击只会拖慢击沉进度。
optionExplanations_en: Falling back to blind scan order throws away the hit you just got, forcing a guess from scratch.
Before you know which way the ship runs, queuing all four neighbors is how you don't miss it.
Firing only rightward bets the ship runs that way; left or vertical ships miss every shot.
Waiting on `all_sunk()` fires no extra shots, skipping the chase just stalls sinking the ship.

q: 填空：当最短船长是 3 时，打所有满足 {{(row + col) % 3 == 0}} 的格子可以保证每艘 3 格直船至少被碰到一次。
q_en: Fill in: with minimum ship length 3, firing at cells where {{(row + col) % 3 == 0}} guarantees touching every straight 3-cell ship.
text: 当最短船长是 3 时，打所有满足 {{(row + col) % 3 == 0}} 的格子可以保证每艘 3 格直船至少被碰到一次。
why: 任意连续 3 个整数的模 3 余数会覆盖 0、1、2。横船和竖船的 row+col 都形成连续值，所以三格船必有一格落在 hunt 集合里。
why_en: Every length-three horizontal or vertical ship spans three consecutive row-plus-column sums, including one divisible by three.

termDefinitions.meaning: hunt 阶段用的稀疏格局：只打行列坐标之和能被 3 整除的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modulo-three pattern only fires at cells where row plus column is divisible by three.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取模运算：整数除以 3 后的余数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo three is the remainder left after dividing an integer by three.

q: 为什么 mod-3 hunt 对 3 格横船和竖船都成立？
q_en: Why does mod-3 hunt work for both horizontal and vertical 3-cell ships?
options: 横向相邻时 col 每次加 1，row+col 连续变化
纵向相邻时 row 每次加 1，row+col 连续变化
三个连续整数的模 3 余数一定各出现一次
所有船都必须从 `(0, 0)` 开始
options_en: For a horizontal ship, col increases by 1 each step, so row+col changes by 1 each time
For a vertical ship, row increases by 1 each step, so row+col changes by 1 each time
Any three consecutive integers hit every residue mod three exactly once
Every ship must start at `(0, 0)`
why: 证明只依赖轴对齐和长度至少 3。它不依赖船出现在哪一行、哪一列。
why_en: The guarantee follows from axis alignment and three consecutive sums, not from any particular ship location.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取模运算：整数除以 3 后的余数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo three is the remainder left after dividing an integer by three.

optionExplanations: 横船每格 col 加一，row+col 也跟着逐格加一，这一步是证明成立的前提。
竖船同理，row 每格加一，row+col 同样逐格递增，跟横船是对称的论证。
任意三个连续整数取模 3，结果必然覆盖 0、1、2 三种余数各一次。
船的起点在棋盘哪里都不影响证明，这个「必须从原点开始」的说法是编出来的。
optionExplanations_en: For a horizontal ship, col climbs by one each cell, so row+col climbs by one too — the proof needs this.
Vertical ships mirror that: row climbs by one each cell, so row+col rises the same way.
Any three consecutive integers modulo three land on 0, 1, and 2 exactly once between them.
Where a ship starts has no bearing on the proof; the "must start at the origin" claim is invented.
scenario: 舰队最短船长为 3 且轴对齐，你想只打 (row+col)%3==0 的格子还不漏船。
scenario_en: Ships are axis-aligned with minimum length 3, and you want to fire only on (row+col)%3==0 cells without missing any.

scenario: 舰队里最短船长为 3，你想在不知道位置的情况下减少搜索格子，同时不能漏掉任何船。
scenario_en: The shortest ship has length 3; you want fewer search cells without missing any ship.
q: 应该选择哪种 hunt 集合？
q_en: Which hunt set should you choose?
options: 只打棋盘的主对角线一条斜线上的格子
只打棋盘边缘格子
只打 mod-3 稀疏格子
只打所有偶数行格子
options_en: Only fire along the board's single main-diagonal line
Only fire at the board's edge cells
Only fire at the sparse mod-3 cells
Only fire on every even-numbered row
tradeoff: 稀疏覆盖证明（省枪但要满足最短船长前提） vs 简单几何格局（无覆盖保证）
why: mod-3 格局大约覆盖三分之一棋盘，却对所有 3 格以上直船保留一次命中保证。其它集合没有通用覆盖证明。
why_en: The modulo-three hunt pattern cuts the search space while retaining a formal coverage guarantee for length-three ships.
whenOtherWins: 如果最短船长变成 2，就应该改用更密的 mod-2 奇偶模式或其它覆盖方案。

termDefinitions.meaning: hunt 阶段用的稀疏格局：只打行列坐标之和能被 3 整除的格子，即 (row + col) % 3 == 0。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modulo-three pattern only fires at cells where row plus column is divisible by three.

optionExplanations: 对角线只有 n 个格子，横向或竖向的船很容易整艘都躲在对角线以外。
边缘格局只覆盖棋盘外圈，中间区域的船一格都碰不到。
mod-3 格局按证明保证长度≥3 的直线船必落一格在集合里，且只占约三分之一棋盘。
偶数行格局对横向 3 格船没有保证：船完全落在同一奇数行时会被整体漏掉。
optionExplanations_en: The diagonal only has n cells, a horizontal or vertical ship can sit entirely off it.
Edge-only cells cover just the border, any ship in the middle rows never gets touched.
Mod-3 is proven to land one cell on any straight ship of length three or more, at ~1/3 board cost.
Even rows give no guarantee for a length-three ship sitting entirely on one odd row.

scenario: 10x10 棋盘上，mod-3 hunt 集合大约是 100/3，实际有 34 个候选格。
scenario_en: On a 10x10 board, the mod-3 hunt set is about 100/3, or 34 candidate cells.
q: mod-3 hunt 集合大小最直接影响什么？
q_en: What does the size of the mod-3 hunt set most directly affect?
text: 把候选格从 100 降到 34，直接降低的是{{hunt 阶段的射击预算}}。
why: 稀疏 hunt 把基线的 100 个潜在探针降到 34 个（100/3 向上取整），这个数字直接决定了 hunt 阶段大约要花多少枪；target 阶段再补上击沉已发现船的开销。
why_en: The sparse hunt set shrinks the blind search space from 100 candidates to 34, which sets the rough shot budget the hunt phase alone will spend.

q: 为什么优化解把 hunt 列表打乱，而不是固定行优先遍历？
q_en: Why does the optimized solver shuffle the hunt list instead of scanning row-first?
options: 打乱会破坏 mod-3 覆盖证明
打乱能让 seeded 多局平均不被固定顺序主导
打乱能让 `check_shot` 跑得更快
打乱之后就能省掉 `tried` 集合
options_en: Shuffling would break the modulo-three coverage guarantee
Shuffling keeps the average over seeded layouts from being dominated by one fixed order
Shuffling makes `check_shot` run faster
Shuffling lets the solver drop the `tried` set entirely
tradeoff: 随机顺序换更公平的基准平均 vs 固定顺序换可复现的单次轨迹
why: 覆盖集合不变，改变的是先后顺序。随机顺序让基准更像平均搜索，而不是押注某个行优先开局特别幸运。
why_en: Shuffling preserves coverage but avoids overfitting the benchmark to one deterministic traversal order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 固定随机数种子生成的布局：同一个种子每次都能复现同一组随机棋盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A seeded layout comes from a fixed random seed, so the same seed always reproduces the same board.

termDefinitions.meaning: 求解器自己维护的坐标集合，记录哪些格子已经射击过，避免重复射击浪费预算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The tried set is a coordinate set the solver keeps to avoid firing at the same cell twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：传入 (row, col)，返回 HIT/SUNK/MISS 三选一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: check_shot is the given API call that takes a row and column and returns HIT, SUNK, or MISS.

optionExplanations: 打乱只调整候选的先后次序，mod-3 覆盖集合本身一个格子都没变，证明照样成立。
不打乱的话，某个固定顺序可能恰好先踩中所有船，平均数就会被这种巧合带偏。
打乱顺序不会碰 `check_shot` 内部实现，跑多快跟这个改动没关系。
换了顺序不代表坐标不会重复被弹出，`tried` 集合还是要单独维护。
optionExplanations_en: Shuffling only reorders candidates, it doesn't drop a single cell from the mod-3 coverage set.
Without shuffling, one fixed order might happen to line up with every ship early, skewing the average.
Shuffling never touches how `check_shot` runs internally, it's unrelated to that call's speed.
A different order can still pop the same coordinate twice, the `tried` set is still needed.
scenario: 评测用 20 个随机 seed 的布局取平均枪数，你要让基准反映平均水平而非某个开局。
scenario_en: The benchmark averages shots over 20 seeded layouts, so the number must reflect average search, not one lucky opening.

q: 固定行优先 hunt 在多 seed 平均测试中最大的风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk of row-first hunt in a multi-seed average test?
options: 固定顺序下不能再命中横向船
某些布局顺序异常好或异常差，平均数对顺序敏感
固定扫描顺序会把 target 目标队列变成一个后进先出的栈
固定顺序会让重复射击不再返回 MISS
options_en: It can no longer hit horizontal ships
Some layout orders run unusually well or badly, so the average becomes sensitive to ordering bias
A fixed scan order turns the target queue into a last-in-first-out stack
Repeated shots stop returning MISS
why: 固定顺序把性能和船在棋盘上的相对位置强绑定。打乱顺序降低这种测试偶然性。
why_en: A fixed traversal can make benchmark results depend too much on where ships happen to sit relative to that order.

termDefinitions.meaning: check_shot 返回值之一：打在空水域，或者重复射击了已经打过的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MISS means the shot hit open water, or repeated a cell that was already fired at.

optionExplanations: 固定顺序照样会扫到横向船所在的格子，命不命中跟顺序本身无关。
船排在扫描早段的布局几枪就能测完，排在末段的却要打到最后，平均数被这种运气拉偏。
遍历顺序只影响先打哪格，target 队列用的还是 FIFO，不会变成后进先出的栈。
MISS 的判定逻辑在 Board 那一层，跟求解器用什么顺序扫描完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: A fixed order still eventually scans a horizontal ship's cells, hits don't depend on order.
A layout with ships early in the scan finishes fast; one with ships late drags out, skewing the average.
Traversal order only changes firing order, the target queue is still a FIFO, not a stack.
MISS is decided inside the Board object, it's unrelated to what order the solver scans in.
scenario: 评分只看 20 个 seed 的平均枪数，单局波动会直接进入这个平均值。
scenario_en: Scoring is the mean shots over 20 seeded layouts, so per-game variance lands straight in that average.

scenario: target 模式要围绕已命中的格子逐层探索邻居，避免一开始就押错方向钻太深。
scenario_en: Target mode should explore neighbors around known hits layer by layer, without committing too deeply to one direction.
q: 最自然的数据结构是什么？
q_en: Which data structure is the natural fit?
options: FIFO 队列
只保存一个整数计数器
排序后的全局 heap
不可变字符串
options_en: A FIFO queue
A single integer counter
A globally sorted heap
An immutable string
tradeoff: FIFO 广度优先扩散（先探完四周再扩） vs heap 全局排序追击（复杂度更高、不必要）
why: FIFO 队列对应 BFS 式扩展，先均匀试探四周，再由后续 HIT 继续扩展。它比单方向贪心更稳。
why_en: A FIFO queue gives a breadth-first target phase around each hit.
whenOtherWins: 如果你已经由两个连续 HIT 明确了方向，只沿该轴延伸可以进一步减少试探邻居。

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的队列：先入队的坐标先被取出探测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A FIFO queue pops coordinates in the same order they were added, first in and first out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 堆：能快速取出最小/最大元素的数据结构，这里指按某种优先级排序的全局候选集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A heap is a structure that quickly returns the smallest or largest element, used here as a globally prioritized candidate set.

optionDiagrams:
flowchart LR
  Hit[Hit cell] --> N1[Up]
  Hit --> N2[Down]
  Hit --> N3[Left]
  Hit --> N4[Right]
  N1 --> Q[Target queue]
  N2 --> Q
  N3 --> Q
  N4 --> Q
optionExplanations: FIFO 队列先进先出，天然按发现顺序依次探测四邻居，符合逐层扩散的需要。
计数器只能存一个数字，没法同时记住四个待探测坐标，信息直接丢了。
全局 heap 需要按优先级排序，这里所有候选价值相同，多花 O(log n) 排序没意义。
字符串不可变意味着每次入队都要整体重建，拿来存一堆动态坐标很别扭。
optionExplanations_en: A FIFO queue pops in discovery order, naturally probing the four neighbors layer by layer.
A single counter can only hold one number, it can't remember four pending coordinates at once.
A global heap needs a priority to sort by, every candidate here is equally valuable, the sort buys nothing.
An immutable string has to be rebuilt whole on every append, an awkward way to hold coordinates.

q: 第一次 HIT 后，把四邻居入队的直接目的有哪些？
q_en: After the first HIT, what are the direct reasons to enqueue the four neighbors?
options: 寻找第二个船格
推断船的横向或纵向轴线
尽快让当前船进入 SUNK
证明剩余 hunt 格子都不需要打
options_en: Find a second ship cell
Infer whether the ship runs horizontally or vertically
Push the current ship toward SUNK as fast as possible
Prove the remaining hunt cells never need to be fired at
why: 第一次 HIT 只说明这里有船，无法确定方向。邻居探测能补足方向信息并推进击沉。
why_en: Neighbor probes turn a single hit into enough information to identify and finish the ship.

termDefinitions.meaning: check_shot 返回值之一：这一枪刚好是某艘船的最后一个格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SUNK means this exact shot destroyed the last remaining cell of a ship.

optionExplanations: 只有一格命中时还不知道船身还占哪些格，邻居探测就是在找第二个船格。
拿到第二个船格后就能看出这两格是同行还是同列，从而定出船的轴线。
定出方向后沿轴线追打，能比继续盲扫更快把这艘船的所有格子打完变 SUNK。
邻居探测跟剩余 hunt 格子要不要打是两件事，扩展四邻居不构成这种证明。
optionExplanations_en: One hit alone doesn't say which other cells the ship occupies, probing neighbors finds the second cell.
Once you have a second ship cell, same row or column tells you the ship's axis.
Once the axis is known, chasing along it finishes the ship into SUNK faster than blind search.
Probing neighbors has nothing to do with proving the rest of the hunt cells are unnecessary.
scenario: hunt 阶段刚在稀疏格子上打出第一个 HIT，你还不知道船是横是竖。
scenario_en: You just got your first HIT on a sparse hunt cell and still do not know if the ship runs across or down.

q: target 模式中，第二个相邻 HIT 最重要的信息是什么？
q_en: In target mode, what is the most important signal from the second adjacent HIT?
options: 船的长度一定是 2
船的方向轴线已经暴露
棋盘上没有其它船
下一枪必须回到 hunt 列表
options_en: The ship's length must be 2
The ship's axis direction is now revealed
There are no other ships left on the board
The next shot must go back to the hunt list
why: 两个相邻命中格确定了船沿行或列延伸。后续可以优先沿同一轴完成这艘船。
why_en: Two adjacent hits reveal the ship's axis.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开环发现阶段维护的稀疏候选坐标列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The hunt list is the sparse set of candidate coordinates used in the discovery phase.

diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[First HIT] --> B[Try neighbors]
  B --> C[Second adjacent HIT]
  C --> D{Same row?}
  D -->|yes| E[Chase left right]
  D -->|no| F[Chase up down]
optionExplanations: 两格相邻只说明船至少有这两格，不能反推出船的总长度正好是 2。
两个相邻命中格一个同行一个同列，方向就此确定，可以沿着这条轴继续追。
这两格只属于当前这艘船，跟棋盘上还有没有别的船完全没关系。
已经拿到方向线索时回 hunt 列表反而浪费，应该沿轴继续追击。
optionExplanations_en: Two adjacent hits only prove the ship covers those two cells, not that its length is exactly two.
Two adjacent hits in the same row or column pin down the axis, so you can keep chasing along it.
Those two cells only belong to the current ship, they say nothing about other ships existing.
Going back to the hunt list once you have a direction wastes the lead, keep chasing the axis instead.
scenario: 你已经在 target 阶段连中两格，接下来每一枪都想花在同一艘船上。
scenario_en: You have two adjacent hits in target mode and want every next shot spent on that same ship.

q: 优化解在什么返回结果下会扩展四邻居？
q_en: For which return values does the optimized solver expand four neighbors?
options: HIT
SUNK
MISS
重复射击返回的 MISS
options_en: HIT
SUNK
MISS
The MISS returned by a repeated shot
why: HIT 和 SUNK 都说明当前格子是船格。MISS 不提供相邻船格的强信号。
why_en: Both HIT and SUNK mark a ship cell, while MISS does not justify neighbor expansion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 命中了船格，但这艘船还没被完全打沉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HIT means the shot landed on a ship cell that hasn't been fully sunk yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 这一枪刚好是某艘船的最后一个格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SUNK means this exact shot destroyed the last remaining cell of a ship.

termDefinitions.meaning: 打在空水域，或者重复射击了已经打过的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MISS means the shot hit open water, or repeated a cell that was already fired at.

optionExplanations: HIT 说明这格是船身，邻居很可能是同一艘船的下一格，值得扩展。
SUNK 同样落在船格上，只是刚好是最后一格，邻居仍可能属于贴边的另一艘船。
MISS 说明这里是空水域，邻居没有比别处更高的概率，不该被优先扩展。
重复射击的 MISS 连新信息都没有，更没有理由拿它去扩展任何邻居。
optionExplanations_en: HIT means the cell is part of a ship, its neighbors are likely the next cell of that ship.
SUNK also lands on a ship cell, just the final one, its neighbors can still belong to an adjacent ship.
MISS means open water, its neighbors are no more promising than anywhere else.
A MISS from a repeat shot carries no new information, an even weaker reason to expand anything.
scenario: 每枪都计入 50 枪预算，你要决定哪些返回值值得把四邻居排队。
scenario_en: Every shot counts against the 50-shot budget, so you must decide which return values are worth queueing neighbors for.

scenario: target 队列可能加入 hunt 已经打过的格子，hunt 后面也可能遇到 target 打过的格子；重复射击仍然计入枪数。
scenario_en: The target queue may include cells already hit by hunt, and hunt may later see cells already hit by target; repeats still count.
q: 最应该加入哪种状态？
q_en: Which state should you add?
options: 维护 `tried` 坐标集合，弹出候选时去重
只记录最后一次射击坐标
把所有 MISS 从棋盘上删除
直接用 `all_sunk()` 的返回值代替坐标去重
options_en: Keep a `tried` set and dedupe when popping a candidate
Only remember the single most recent shot coordinate
Delete every MISS cell from the board
Use the `all_sunk()` return value in place of coordinate dedup
tradeoff: 维护全量 tried 集合（多一点内存） vs 只记最后一枪或不去重（省内存但重复浪费预算）
why: 同一个坐标可能从不同路径进入候选集合。弹出时去重能同时保护 hunt 和 target 两条来源。
why_en: A tried set prevents duplicate probes regardless of whether a coordinate came from hunt or target mode.
whenOtherWins: 如果底层 API 对重复射击免费且不计入预算，去重的重要性会下降。

termDefinitions.meaning: 求解器自己维护的坐标集合，记录哪些格子已经射击过，避免重复射击浪费预算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The tried set is a coordinate set the solver keeps to avoid firing at the same cell twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：判断舰队里所有船是否都已经沉没。

termDefinitions.meaning: check_shot 返回值之一：打在空水域，或者重复射击了已经打过的格子。

flowchart LR
  Candidate[Candidate cell] --> Tried{Already tried?}
  Tried -->|yes| Skip[Skip]
  Tried -->|no| Shot[check shot]

optionExplanations: 候选可能来自 hunt，也可能来自 target，弹出时按坐标查表能同时护住这两条来源。
只记最后一枪等于把前面所有坐标全忘掉，倒数第二个候选一冒出来就会被重复打。
MISS 格子本身没有坐标冲突问题，删掉它们既不解决重复射击，也丢了已探索的记录。
`all_sunk()` 只回答船是否都沉了，跟某个坐标是否打过完全是两件事。
optionExplanations_en: A candidate can slip in through hunt or through target, the pop-time check has to cover both paths.
Remembering only the last shot forgets every earlier coordinate, the prior candidate gets re-fired.
MISS cells aren't the source of duplicates, deleting them neither stops repeats nor keeps history.
`all_sunk()` only answers whether the fleet is destroyed, a separate question from a tried coordinate.

scenario: 你从 `targets` 或 `hunt` 中取出一个候选坐标，准备调用 `check_shot`。
scenario_en: You pop a candidate coordinate from `targets` or `hunt` and are about to call `check_shot`.
q: 去重检查应该放在哪里最稳？
q_en: Where is the safest place to dedupe?
options: 候选入队前永远不检查
弹出候选后，射击前检查并跳过已尝试坐标
射击后才检查是否重复
只在最初生成 hunt 列表那一次检查坐标
options_en: Never check before a candidate is enqueued
After popping a candidate, check right before firing and skip if already tried
Only check for duplicates after the shot has already fired
Only check once, at the moment the hunt list is first generated
tradeoff: 射击前最终检查（多一次判断，最可靠） vs 更早或更晚检查（省判断但漏掉入队后才产生的重复）
codeSample:
if (row, col) in tried:
    continue
tried.add((row, col))
result = self.board.check_shot(row, col)
why: 同一坐标可能在入队后、弹出前被另一条路径打掉。射击前的最终检查才是可靠防线。
why_en: Deduplicating just before firing is the safest guard because queued candidates may become stale.
whenOtherWins: 如果队列结构支持全局 membership 且所有来源都严格同步，入队去重也可以成立，但实现更容易漏边界。

termDefinitions.meaning: 求解器自己维护的坐标集合，记录哪些格子已经射击过，避免重复射击浪费预算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The tried set is a coordinate set the solver keeps to avoid firing at the same cell twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：传入 (row, col)，返回 HIT/SUNK/MISS 三选一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: check_shot is the given API call that takes a row and column and returns HIT, SUNK, or MISS.

optionExplanations: 入队前完全不查，同一坐标可能被 hunt 和 target 各塞一次，最后重复射击两次。
候选在队列里等待期间可能已经被别的路径打过，弹出后开枪前再查一次才不会漏判。
先开枪再判断重复，预算已经花出去了，检查放在这里等于马后炮。
hunt 列表只在一开始生成一次，后面 target 陆续塞入的坐标根本没被这次检查覆盖到。
optionExplanations_en: With no check before enqueueing, hunt and target can both push the same coordinate in and fire twice.
A queued candidate can go stale while waiting, checking right before firing catches what earlier steps missed.
Checking after firing is too late, the shot budget is already spent by the time you notice.
The hunt list is built once at the start, this check never sees coordinates target adds later.

q: 为什么重复射击在这个题里特别危险？
q_en: Why are repeated shots especially dangerous in this problem?
options: 它会抛异常导致程序退出
它返回 MISS 但仍计入射击次数预算
它会重置所有船的状态
它会让 `all_sunk()` 永远为 false
options_en: It throws an exception and crashes the program
It returns MISS but still counts against the shot budget
It resets the state of every ship
It makes `all_sunk()` return false forever
why: 重复坐标不会帮你获得新信息，却消耗一次预算。优化测试测的正是这类浪费。
why_en: Repeated shots are pure cost because they count against the budget while adding no information.

termDefinitions.meaning: check_shot 返回值之一：打在空水域，或者重复射击了已经打过的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MISS means the shot hit open water, or repeated a cell that was already fired at.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：判断舰队里所有船是否都已经沉没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: all_sunk is the given API that reports whether every ship in the fleet has been destroyed.

optionExplanations: 题目给的 API 不会因为重复坐标抛异常，程序照样正常往下跑。
重复射击照样拿到一次 MISS，但这一枪的预算已经花出去了，没换来任何新信息。
重复射击不会碰船的内部状态，已经命中或沉没的记录都还在。
重复射击跟 `all_sunk()` 的判定逻辑无关，该沉的船照样会沉。

A repeat shot still returns MISS, but that shot is already spent from the budget for no new information.
Firing at a repeat doesn't touch any ship's internal state, prior hits and sinks stay recorded.
Repeated shots have nothing to do with how `all_sunk()` is evaluated, ships still sink normally.
scenario: 预算按调用次数算，而不是按打到新格子的次数算。
scenario_en: The budget counts calls to the API, not the number of new cells you actually uncover.

scenario: 一次射击返回 SUNK，当前船已经沉没，但题目允许不同船边贴边放置。
scenario_en: A shot returns SUNK, so the current ship is gone, but the rules allow different ships to touch edges.
q: 优化解为什么仍然可以扩展这个 SUNK 格子的邻居？
q_en: Why can the optimized solver still expand neighbors of this SUNK cell?

利用最小目标尺寸可以设计稀疏覆盖模式
命中后的局部追击常常比继续盲扫更划算
只要正确性通过，就一定能通过效率测试

scenario_en: The target queue holds four neighbors of a fresh hit while the hunt list still has dozens of sparse cells; you must pick which queue to pop each round.
q: 如果每轮先弹 hunt、把 target 留到 hunt 耗尽再处理，会发生什么？
q_en: What happens if you pop hunt first each round and defer the target queue until hunt is exhausted?
options: 命中的船迟迟不沉，target 队列越积越多，预算被盲搜稀释
mod-3 覆盖保证失效，靠边的短船可能整艘被漏掉
hunt 与 target 会重复射击同一格，`tried` 去重随之失效
`all_sunk()` 会提前误判为 true，漏掉还没沉的船
options_en: Discovered ships stay unsunk, the target queue piles up, and budget bleeds into blind search
The mod-3 coverage guarantee breaks and edge-hugging short ships get missed entirely
Hunt and target re-fire the same cell, so the `tried` dedup stops working
`all_sunk()` flips true too early and leaves an un-sunk ship behind
tradeoff: 先排空 target 追击（把一艘船一次收尾） vs 先走 hunt 盲搜（发现更均匀但把已知船晾着漏预算）
why: target 收尾已锁定的船、hunt 是盲搜；先 hunt 把半沉的船晾着去赌新格子，船不沉预算就一直漏，所以写成 `if targets: … elif hunt`。代价是追击优先会先在一艘船上试错几枪。
why_en: The target queue finishes a ship you already found, so draining it before resuming the sparse hunt stops budget leaking into blind search while a half-sunk ship waits.
whenOtherWins: 如果反馈追击的期望收益低于盲搜（例如船不连续、邻居几乎总是空水），优先盲搜才更划算。

termDefinitions.meaning: 闭环追击阶段维护的候选坐标队列，命中后把四邻居放进去优先打。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The target queue holds candidate coordinates queued after a hit, drained first to finish that ship.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开环发现阶段维护的稀疏候选坐标列表，只打 (row+col)%3==0 的格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The hunt list is the sparse set of candidate coordinates used to discover new ships.

termDefinitions.meaning: 求解器自己维护的坐标集合，记录哪些格子已经射击过，避免重复射击浪费预算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The tried set is a coordinate set the solver keeps to avoid firing at the same cell twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 题目给定的 API：判断舰队里所有船是否都已经沉没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: all_sunk is the given API that reports whether every ship in the fleet has been destroyed.

optionExplanations: 先 hunt 会把已发现的船挂在半沉状态，它的邻居一直排在 target 里没人打，枪都花在盲搜新格子上。
取用顺序只影响先打哪格，mod-3 集合本身一格没变，覆盖证明照样成立，跟顺序无关。
去重靠弹出时查 `tried` 集合完成，跟先弹哪个队列无关，换顺序不会让 `tried` 失效。
`all_sunk()` 的判定在 Board 那层，只有真把所有船打沉才会变 true，顺序不会让它提前误报。
optionExplanations_en: Popping hunt first leaves the found ship half-sunk while its neighbors sit in target, spending shots on blind cells.
Pop order only changes which cell fires first; the mod-3 set is unchanged, so its coverage proof still holds.
Dedup happens by checking the `tried` set on pop, independent of which queue you drain first.
`all_sunk()` is decided by the Board and only turns true once every ship is truly sunk, order can't fool it.

scenario: hunt 阶段在一格上打出 HIT，target 阶段接手把这艘 3 格 Cruiser 一路打到 SUNK。
scenario_en: Hunt lands a HIT on one cell and target mode takes over, chasing the 3-cell Cruiser all the way to SUNK.
q: target 阶段完整击沉这艘船，这些枪由哪些部分构成？
q_en: In target mode, how do the shots that fully sink this ship break down?
options: 8 枪 = 3 船格 + 5 试错水格
3 枪 = 3 船格，无水格开销
6 枪 = 3 船格 + 3 相邻水格
12 枪 = 3 船格 + 每格 4 邻居
options_en: 8 shots = 3 ship cells + 5 wrong-direction water cells
3 shots = just the 3 ship cells, no water overhead
6 shots = 3 ship cells + 3 adjacent water cells
12 shots = 3 ship cells + 4 neighbors of each cell
why: 一次完整击沉≈8 枪：3 枪打船格（2 HIT + 1 SUNK），5 枪是判断方向时打空的邻居水格。这份 per-ship 开销叠加在≈34 个 hunt 候选上，是平均枪数停在 33 附近的原因。
why_en: A full sink costs about 8 shots: 3 land on ship cells (two HITs plus the final SUNK) and 5 are wrong-direction neighbor probes into water.

termDefinitions.meaning: 命中了船格，但这艘船还没被完全打沉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HIT means the shot landed on a ship cell that hasn't been fully sunk yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 这一枪刚好是某艘船的最后一个格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SUNK means this exact shot destroyed the last remaining cell of a ship.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开环发现阶段维护的稀疏候选坐标列表，10x10 上约 34 个格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The hunt list is the sparse discovery set, about 34 cells on a 10x10 board.

scenario: 面试官追问：为什么不像已知的最优 Battleship AI 那样，对所有可能船位算概率密度热力图来选下一枪？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks why you didn't build a probability-density heatmap over all possible ship placements to pick each shot, like a known-optimal Battleship AI.
q: 为什么这里只保留「最近几次 HIT」的最小状态，而不上概率密度模型？
q_en: Why keep only the minimal 'last few HITs' state here instead of a probability-density model?
options: 解法已稳过 50 预算，概率模型的复杂度换不回相称的省枪收益
换成概率密度模型才能保证一定能打完所有船，否则会漏船
概率密度模型会破坏 mod-3 hunt 那条数学覆盖保证
概率模型要求 `check_shot` 一次返回整艘船的坐标才能算概率
options_en: The solver already clears the 50-shot budget, so a probability model's cost buys too little
Only a probability-density model can guarantee every ship is eventually sunk, else ships get missed
A probability-density model would break the mod-3 hunt's mathematical coverage guarantee
A probability model needs `check_shot` to return a whole ship's coordinates to compute probabilities
tradeoff: 最小状态（实现简单、够用但非最优） vs 概率密度/枚举/博弈树（更省几枪但复杂度和计算大得多）
why: 瓶颈不是「不够聪明」而是「别浪费」——hunt+target 记住最近几次 HIT 就把 68 枪砍到 33，稳过 50 预算；概率模型多花大量实现和计算，只在预算逼近理论最优时才回本。代价是这套解法不是枪数最优，会比概率模型多打几枪。
why_en: The bottleneck is wasted shots, not lack of cleverness, and remembering the last few HITs already cuts 68 shots to 33, comfortably under the 50 budget, so a probability model's cost only pays off when you need near-optimal shots.
whenOtherWins: 如果预算收紧到逼近理论最优，或船更多更密、每枪的信息增益更值钱，概率密度模型才值那份额外复杂度。

termDefinitions.meaning: 枚举所有可能船位、给每格算一个「是船」的概率，再打概率最高格的下一枪策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A probability-density model enumerates all possible ship placements and fires at the cell most likely to hold a ship.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每一步射击及其后续可能局面展开成一棵树来搜索最优走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A game tree expands each shot and its resulting states into a tree to search for the optimal move.

termDefinitions.meaning: 命中了船格，但这艘船还没被完全打沉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HIT means the shot landed on a ship cell that hasn't been fully sunk yet.

optionExplanations: 解法已经稳过预算，概率模型的建模和计算开销换来的边际省枪很小，不值得在面试里加这层复杂度。
完成保证其实来自 mod-3 的数学性质，不是概率模型给的；概率模型只改选格顺序，不提供额外的完成保证。
覆盖保证来自 mod-3 的数学性质，换成概率模型只是改选格策略，不会动到那条数学保证。
概率模型和 hunt+target 一样只吃单点反馈，不需要也拿不到整艘船的坐标，这是把 API 语义搞混了。
optionExplanations_en: The solver already clears the budget, so a probability model's modeling and compute cost buys tiny marginal savings.
Completion is guaranteed by the mod-3 math, not by a probability model, which only reorders which cells you probe.
The coverage guarantee comes from mod-3 math; swapping in a probability model only changes cell selection, not that proof.
A probability model uses single-cell feedback just like hunt+target, it neither needs nor gets a full ship's coordinates.
